SenseLink

Lighting that regulates itself, without extra cabling, a separate controller or manual configuration. Discover how SenseLink makes smart lighting control accessible for every project.

Read more

NEW | PRO-BATTEN

LED Pro-Batten is an efficient linear LED luminaire with high light output, uniform light distribution, adjustable light color and brightness, ideal for schools, offices, and semi-industrial spaces.

View

New | Pro-Ambiance

Pro-Ambiance is a cost-effective, small aperture recessed lighting solution with refined aesthetics and quality for residential and hospitality applications, to name a few.

View

NEW | Pro-Aqua Basic

The Pro-Aqua Basic combines high quality and easy installation with adjustable light colors, optional sensors, and simple loop-through wiring, making it a leading and affordable lighting solution.

View

The Prolumia catalog is available

In the Prolumia catalog 2025-2026 you will find the best innovative lighting solutions for numerous lighting challenges.

View

NEW | PRO-LINE LINEAR

A lighting solution for production, warehouse, retail and office spaces, unmatched in both uniformity and luminous efficacy, which is also quick and easy to install. The LED modules are available in switchable or DALI versions, optionally equipped with emergency units.

View

NEW | Pro-Aqua IV

Discover the Pro-Aqua IV, powerful LED lighting with 180 lm/W, advanced features, and quick installation. Ideal for industrial halls, parking garages, and commercial spaces. Save energy and boost reliability.

View

NEW | Prodisc Helios

Create a captivating ambiance with the elegant PRO-HELIOS. Adjustable light color, motion sensor, and emergency lighting in one multifunctional luminaire.

View

NEW | PRO-VIA

Discover Pro-Via – smart street lighting with 160 lm/W, Smart City compatibility, and maintenance-friendly design. Perfect for roads, parking areas, and industrial zones. Enhance safety while saving energy and costs.

View

RENEWED | PRODISC III

Thanks to higher efficiency, extensive adjustment options, and a robust housing, our bestseller is more versatile than ever.

View

RENEWED | PRO-CEILING

The Prolumia Pro-Ceiling series is unique in its design. It combines the warmth of decorative light with the sophistication of a modern, contemporary fixture. Available in a round, square, or rectangular shape.

View

RENEWED | Pro-Office

Modern technology in a classic look: discover the new Pro-Office. Improved luminous efficacy and a significantly extended service life, new options such as the preferred light color option and the 4-step adjustable light settings, make the luminaire flexible and versatile.

View

When lighting matters

LED lighting where quality is paramount. That's Prolumia. The five extensive product groups, consisting of line lighting, indoor and outdoor lighting, industrial lighting and public lighting, enable us to fulfil virtually every lighting wish. We also strive for sustainable customer contact, sound specialist advice for every issue and provide just that little bit extra service. Whatever it is, Prolumia makes no concessions.
